title: Cross-Surface Agent Runtime Hardening

operatorSteps.title: Review cross-surface evidence
operatorSteps.instruction: Review MCP, AI runtime, Kubernetes, and repository posture artifacts for common boundary failures across tool, runtime, infrastructure, and supply-chain planes.

operatorSteps.title: Plan boundary controls
operatorSteps.instruction: Draft a non-executing cross-surface control plan that aligns tool permissions, runtime auth, memory isolation, workload hardening, and repository delivery controls.

operatorSteps.title: Record reassessment commands
operatorSteps.instruction: Record the surface-specific reassessment commands that must be run after approved controls are applied.

recommendedControls: Align MCP tool permissions with AI runtime policy gates.
Require runtime authentication and scoped tokens before enabling tool bindings.
Isolate memory stores by tenant and sensitivity.
Run agent workloads with restricted Kubernetes permissions and pod security controls.
Require repository workflow and branch protections before promoting runtime changes.
Reassess all affected surfaces after approved control changes.
nonClaims: This playbook does not execute tools or prompts.
This playbook does not mutate infrastructure.
This playbook does not deploy code.
This playbook does not authorize live remediation.
